name: krita_paint_stroke
description: Paint one native brush stroke with a Krita brush preset on a paint layer, or reveal or hide on a transparency mask, as one undo step. smooth catmull_rom curves the path through the points. The stroke is checked against protection over its reach (verify region) or the whole canvas (verify full) and undone on a leak. Every point is painted at pressure 1: per-point input is refused unless input_fallback is flat; dynamics tapers size and opacity along the stroke instead.

preset_id.description: A brush preset's id, from krita_resource_list.

preset_sha256.description: The preset's sha256, from krita_resource_list; a preset that differs is refused.

rgba.description: Red, green, blue and alpha, each 0 to 1, not 0 to 255; alpha must be 1. A krita_sample color goes here unchanged.

mask.description: For a transparency mask, in place of color: reveal shows its layer and hide hides it, each moving coverage by the opacity, so 0.5 moves it halfway.

points.description: Canvas px, at least half a pixel long in all. An on-curve point may lie off the canvas by at most half of size_px.

pressure.description: 0 to 1. Any value but 1 is refused unless input_fallback is flat.

tilt_x.description: Degrees, -90 to 90. Refused unless input_fallback is flat.

tilt_y.description: Degrees, -90 to 90. Refused unless input_fallback is flat.

tangential_pressure.description: -1 to 1. Refused unless input_fallback is flat.

smooth.description: catmull_rom curves the path through the points; none, the default, joins them.

input_fallback.description: flat paints every point at pressure 1 and ignores per-point pressure, tilt, rotation, speed and time, which are refused without it.

dynamics.description: Size and opacity along the stroke, each as knots {at, value}: at is the fraction of the stroke's length, from 0 to 1, rising by at least 0.001; value multiplies brush.size_px or brush.opacity there, in straight lines between knots. It drives the preset's Distance sensor for this stroke alone, replacing the preset's own size or opacity sensors, and puts the preset back after. Pixel brush engine and colour paint only; needs brush.preset_sha256 and a stroke at least 1 px long.

at.description: The fraction of the stroke's length, 0 to 1.
The fraction of the stroke's length, 0 to 1.

verify.description: region, the default, checks the stroke's reach, and needs the pixel brush engine with a tip and scatter it can read. full checks the whole canvas: for any other preset, or a filter, mask, style or clone that spreads a change.
